items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Well I know both of Dick's sons, in fact I used one of them for a while there before he left town.

ctx.x: Well he was with Harold Kemp for a while I know because of, I was just talking to his son Sunday when we were talking about that. What? About him being with Harold Kemp, he even recorded with him. Dick did. Dick did, yeah. It was not a very good recording he thought it did.

The sons thought it was fine. Well I know both of Dick's sons, in fact I used one of them for a while there before he left town. He was a drummer he played with, I used him a couple of times. And Dick was responsible for giving Wade Schlegel, did you ever hear Wade Schlegel?
